dex.entry: Brinix's final kindled form. The brine-crest has broadened into a sweeping crown of sea-glass plating; its bulk and endurance are legendary on the southern coast. Becomes the region's apex defender. The satisfying payoff of raising your starter — a true coastal fortress on the field.

art.silhouette: Tall, broad-shouldered, slate-blue shell plating crested with sea-glass spurs in translucent teal. Wide stance, deep chest, a calm but commanding gaze behind a brow-ridge. Dual water-crystal shoulder guards.
